name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2026-07-17, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.76 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
